name: PluginDexAdminPlugin

methods.name: opUp
methods.desc: No-op carrier for opcode budget and resource references

methods.name: acceptAdminOf
methods.desc:
Step 2 of an admin handover: the wallet takes the admin role of `app`, which must have named the
wallet with `proposeAdmin` first. `app` is one of the four apps with a stored admin (errDaTg).

methods.name: proposeAdminOf
methods.desc:
Step 1 of an admin handover, as the current admin: name the account that may take over `app`.
Nothing changes until that account accepts; the zero address cancels a pending handover.

methods.name: vaultSetProtocolFee
methods.desc: Protocol fee (bps of the swap fee, capped by the Vault) and the account that receives it

methods.name: vaultSetHookApproval
methods.desc: Approve a hook app with the most permissions a pool may grant it, or revoke it with 0. The Vault pays the box MBR.

methods.name: vaultSetCurveApproval
methods.desc: Approve or revoke a curve app for future pools

methods.name: vaultSetValuatorApproval
methods.desc: Approve or revoke a valuator for future external slots

methods.name: vaultSetPoolPaused
methods.desc: Pause or unpause a pool. Pausing stops swaps and deposits and opens `emergencyRemoveLiquidity`.

methods.name: vaultWriteDownExternal
methods.desc: Paused pools only: recognize a real venue loss on an external slot

methods.name: launchSetFees
methods.desc: Launch fee, bounty and treasury for future launches

methods.name: launchSetHooks
methods.desc: Hook apps for future launches (each must be approved in the Vault)

methods.name: launchSetDevBuy
methods.desc: Dev-buy policy for future launches (maxBps 0 disables dev buys)

methods.name: backrunSetPaused
methods.desc: Global kill switch of the backrun hook

methods.name: backrunRegisterPool
methods.desc: Register (or re-register) a native pool with the backrun hook. The hook pays the box MBR.

methods.name: backrunSetPoolEnabled
methods.desc: Per-pool kill switch of the backrun hook

methods.name: backrunWithdraw
methods.desc: Withdraw ALGO above the backrun hook's box MBR to its admin, which is the wallet

methods.name: keyregSetPoolKeys
methods.desc: Set (or rotate) a pool's operator and participation keys

methods.name: keyregDeletePoolKeys
methods.desc: Stop managing a pool's consensus keys

methods.name: keyregWithdraw
methods.desc: Send ALGO from the keyreg hook's tank to its admin, which is the wallet

methods.name: gatedSetGateSlots
methods.desc: Redefine which gate each pass bit means (at most 8 slots). The hook pays the box MBR.

methods.name: gatedSetPassTtl
methods.desc: Lifetime of a fee pass in seconds, within the hook's bounds

methods.name: gatedSetMaxDiscountedSwapsPerDay
methods.desc: Cap on discounted swaps per pass per UTC day (0 = unlimited)

methods.name: gatedSetDefaultSchedule
methods.desc: Schedule copied into pools created later with empty initData. The hook pays the box MBR.

desc:
PluginDexAdminPlugin: the ARC-58 plugin a wallet uses to hold the admin role of a Plugin DEX deployment.

Five DEX apps have an admin. Four store one and hand it over in two steps: the Vault (PluginDex),
LaunchManager, BackrunArbHook and ConsensusKeyregHook. GatedFeeHook stores none: its admin is always the
ARC-58 wallet of its DAO. Each checks `Txn.sender`, and a wallet's address is only ever a sender inside a
plugin window. Without this plugin a wallet that is named admin could not accept the role (readiness
audit 2026-11-09, C10) or use it afterwards: pause a pool, change an approval or a fee, set the gates
behind a fee pass.

- The plugin has no authority of its own. Every call is one inner transaction sent as the wallet's
  spending account S, and the target app decides whether S is its admin. A wallet that is not the admin
  gets the target's own "not the admin" error. Use it from the wallet's main account: an escrow is a
  different address and is not the admin.
- S comes from `getControlledSpendingAccount`, which asserts that S is rekeyed to this app right now
  (errNath). An app posing as a wallet cannot make this plugin send from its own account.
- It calls only the five apps pinned at create, never a caller-chosen app.
- One method per admin action, so a wallet can grant a subset: for example only `vaultSetPoolPaused` to
  a guardian key, with everything else left to proposals. The two handover methods end in `Of` so
  that nothing mistakes this plugin for an app that has an admin of its own.

One plugin per Plugin DEX deployment. Immutable and adminless (no update method): the ARC-58 wallet
only accepts plugins whose Application.version is 0.
